# Security and Platform Limits Checklist: GitHub Platform

**Purpose**: Test how well the requirements for GitHub sign-in, access, tokens, and platform limits are written, before tasks are made. It does not test the app.
**Created**: 2026-11-14
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md), [plan.md](../plan.md), [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

Focus: sign-in and access, token handling, pace and limits, the open access gate. Depth: standard. For: the reviewer of the spec and plan pull request.

## Access and the Open Gate

- [ ] CHK001 Does the spec say what the feature moves if a GitHub App token cannot star a repository, or is that outcome left only to the plan? [Gap, Spec §Feasibility, Research R1]
- [ ] CHK002 Are the access levels per app written as exact GitHub permission names and levels, so two readers would set up the same three apps? [Clarity, Spec §GitHub section, "Access per account"]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the permission that star lists need stated, or still marked "plan to confirm" with no owner and no date? [Ambiguity, Spec §What GitHub supports]
- [ ] CHK004 Is "the smallest level that can star a gist" resolved to one named level, or does FR-GH-020 still depend on an unanswered question? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-GH-020]
- [ ] CHK005 Are the requirements for the classic OAuth app option (which access, which exception to Principle III) written anywhere a reviewer could approve them, or only as a table row in research? [Gap, Research R1]
- [ ] CHK006 Does the spec say which app name and access list the user sees on GitHub's consent page for each sign-in, so the in-app text can match it? [Gap]

## Sign-in Requirements

- [ ] CHK007 Is the case "user taps Cancel on GitHub" a numbered requirement, or does it exist only in the table under the sign-in diagram? [Gap, Spec §How "Sign in with a code" works]
- [ ] CHK008 Is "the second sign-in" defined when the steps can be done in any order (To before From)? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-GH-007, §FR-GH-002]
- [ ] CHK009 Is "within a few seconds" in US2 scenario 2 given a number that matches the poll interval the plan uses? [Measurability, Spec §US2]
- [ ] CHK010 Are the values the app must check in GitHub's sign-in answers listed in the spec, or only in the plan? [Completeness, Spec §GitHub section, Research R2]
- [ ] CHK011 Does the spec say what the step shows while the app waits for the user (code, hint, a way to stop waiting)? [Gap, Spec §FR-GH-006]
- [ ] CHK012 Is the wrong-account case defined for all three sign-ins: same account on From and To, different account on the gist sign-in, and a different new account when a saved progress is opened? [Coverage, Spec §FR-GH-007, §US5]
- [ ] CHK013 Are requirements stated for the sign-in code on the clipboard (is it cleared, does it matter that other apps can read it)? [Gap, Spec §FR-GH-006]
- [ ] CHK014 Are accessibility requirements written for the code (how a screen reader reads it, text size limits)? [Gap, Constitution I]

## Token Requirements

- [ ] CHK015 Is "sign out" defined for GitHub, given that the steps have only a Switch button? [Ambiguity, Spec §US4, §FR-GH-005]
- [ ] CHK016 Does the spec say where and when the remove-access line shows (after Switch, at the summary, in Settings, after Delete all)? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GH-019]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the exact GitHub page the remove-access button opens named in the spec? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GH-019]
- [ ] CHK018 Are FR-GH-013 ("deleted on sign-out and on Delete all") and FR-GH-019 (deleted earlier, at the read and at the summary) consistent, or does one need to point to the other? [Consistency, Spec §FR-GH-013, §FR-GH-019]
- [ ] CHK019 Does the spec say what happens when the old account token is gone and the user wants a fresh list from the old account? [Gap, Spec §FR-GH-019]
- [ ] CHK020 Is the case "pause lasts longer than the token's 8 hours" covered by a requirement, not only by an edge case line? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, §US4]
- [ ] CHK021 Does the spec say whether gist access must be given again when a saved progress is continued later? [Gap, Spec §FR-GH-020]
- [ ] CHK022 Is "as short a time as possible" in FR-GH-019 backed by the three listed moments only, with no room for another reading? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GH-019]
- [ ] CHK023 Is the approved exception to Principle III, rule 3 recorded with who approved it and when, in both the spec and the plan? [Traceability, Spec §Clarifications, Plan §Complexity Tracking]

## Pace and Platform Limits

- [ ] CHK024 Is "per new account" in FR-GH-010 clear about several progresses to the same new account, and about adds made before an app restart? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GH-010]
- [ ] CHK025 Does the spec say whether adding a repository to a star list counts as an add for the pace? [Gap, Spec §FR-GH-010, Research R8]
- [ ] CHK026 Is the case "GitHub asks to wait but gives no time" covered in the spec, or only in the plan? [Gap, Spec §FR-GH-012, Research R9]
- [ ] CHK027 Is "GitHub flags the new account" defined by something the app can see, so the edge case can be told apart from a normal refusal? [Measurability, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Is the reminder time for a GitHub pause specified (GitHub's wait time, one hour, or the pace window)? [Gap, Spec §FR-GH-012]
- [ ] CHK029 Is the format of the time-left line defined for short moves, long moves, and moves over the hourly pace? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GH-011]
- [ ] CHK030 Can "no test account is flagged by GitHub" in SC-006 be checked by a reviewer, and is the way to check it stated? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [ ] CHK031 Is the risk from GitHub's rule on automated starring and following accepted by the owner in writing, with the reason? [Assumption, Spec §Feasibility]

## Data and Reads

- [ ] CHK032 Do FR-GH-016 ("check each starred repository with the new account") and the plan's rule (use the `private` flag, no call per repository) say the same thing? [Conflict, Spec §FR-GH-016, Research R7]
- [ ] CHK033 Is the list of reasons a row can show for "Couldn't move" and "Not available" written out, so "never a raw error" can be checked? [Completeness, Spec §FR-GH-017]
- [ ] CHK034 Is "reuse a list with the same name" clear about letter case and about private lists? [Clarity, Spec §FR-GH-018]
- [ ] CHK035 Does a requirement state that moving a star list must not take a repository out of lists it is already in on the new account? [Gap, Spec §FR-GH-009, Research R8]
- [ ] CHK036 Is every kind of data the app keeps for GitHub listed in FR-GH-014, including add times for the pace and the list-to-repository links? [Completeness, Spec §FR-GH-014, Data model]
- [ ] CHK037 Does FR-GH-014's "MUST NOT log" list match Principle III, rule 7 item for item? [Consistency, Spec §FR-GH-014, Constitution III.7]
- [ ] CHK038 Are all hosts the feature opens or calls listed, including the page the remove-access button opens? [Completeness, Spec §GitHub section, "Hosts"]

## Dependencies and Assumptions

- [ ] CHK039 Is every "the plan MUST check" line in the spec answered in the plan or marked as still open? [Traceability, Spec §GitHub section, Research]
- [ ] CHK040 Is the restructure of the Automatic flow stated as a requirement or assumption with its own acceptance check (SC-003), and is the owner's approval recorded? [Traceability, Spec §Assumptions, Plan §Part A]
- [ ] CHK041 Are the Android and iOS differences for opening the browser and reading the clipboard named, or is "works the same way" unsupported? [Assumption, Spec §FR-GH-015]

## Notes
